name: Langdock
h1: Langdock ARR: ~$50M for the EU-Native AI Platform for Companies.
intro: Langdock is the central AI platform for organizations — chat with every major model, company knowledge connected, agents and automations on top — with European data residency as the deal-closing differentiator. Leonis Capital charts roughly $50M reached in thirty-six months; Dealroom pegs the run rate around $40M. The reported numbers are below.

modelTitle: Sell Governance, Not Access to a Model.
modelParagraphs: Any employee can buy a ChatGPT subscription; what they can't buy is one AI platform the company governs — every major model behind one interface, company knowledge connected with permissions intact, usage auditable, data staying in the EU. That governance layer is what Langdock prices, which is why model releases help rather than threaten it.

Revenue is per-seat platform subscriptions with enterprise contracts for the compliance tier — data residency, permissions and audit — the checklist items European regulated buyers require before adoption. The thirty-six-month path to $50M is slower than consumer AI ramps, but each contract lands the whole organization rather than a single user.

faqs.a: Estimates cluster between $40M and $50M: Leonis Capital charts roughly $50M reached in thirty-six months, while Dealroom separately tracks ~$40M. Langdock has not disclosed revenue; treat the range as estimates.
A central AI platform for organizations: chat with every major model, company knowledge connected with permissions, and agents and automations on top — governed, audited and hosted in the EU.

faqs.q: Why Does EU Data Residency Matter So Much?
faqs.a: Regulated European buyers — healthcare, finance, public sector — often can't send data to US-hosted AI services regardless of product quality. A platform that keeps data in the EU clears the procurement checklist those organizations run before anything else.
Jonas Niehues and Lucca Brehm founded the company in Berlin in 2023 — building the governed, organization-wide AI platform from Europe rather than a consumer chat front-end.

faqs.q: Isn't This Just a ChatGPT Wrapper?
faqs.a: The chat layer is the least of it: the value is governance — model choice, permissions on connected knowledge, audit trails, EU residency — the parts no individual consumer subscription provides and no regulated company will skip.

ctaTitle: Selling AI to Regulated Buyers? Bill the Whole Org.
ctaDescription: Clink runs per-seat platform billing, mid-cycle seat changes and enterprise invoicing with tax handled across the EU — for AI platforms whose buyers demand compliance paperwork.
